title: Raising his siblings after his father left at 13
summary: Emile says he worked from age 13 when his father left, raised his sister and brother and paid for brother Paul's schooling.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Mr. Bill, I waited all my days since I was 13. My daddy left home when I was 13 years old.
And you had to work then?

I raised my sister and my brother, that same boy you see Paul there? I paid for his schooling. Yeah, I paid for his schooling. You see that he went to school? Not me, see that he'd go, but my mother was there, she had him. In fact, none of us was all to get along. He went to school, Paul ought to... Right now, I think Paul got more educated than thinking, gotcha. Don't think he's dumb.
No, but I tell you what's the matter, he's too much like that. If he wanted like that, he just wanted like that.
